label: Containment in every cause entails that nothing gives being it does not have (inference)
rule: Instantiate a universal at the respect esse
meaning: Strength order registration: containment in every cause, at r = esse, says that whatever causes the being of a thing in act as to being is itself in act as to being (4a5a43a5). Same InAct, CausesIn and esse. It establishes neither statement.
